## Highlights

- Bundles `horus-gateway` 0.7.1 and `horus` 0.7.1.
- Opens `/subagents` pickers and transcript previews while the parent turn is still running.

## Install or upgrade

```sh
horus-gateway exit
cargo install --force --locked horus-cli --version 0.7.1
horus-gateway serve --background
```

- Gateway protocol 23 and configuration version 14 are unchanged.
